## Projects

Each project was checked against its repository. Limits are stated, not hidden. AWS and Azure resources were torn down after testing.

1. Identity Threat Detection and Response Lab. One t3.large on AWS (Terraform) running HashiCorp Vault 1.15 and a single-node Wazuh 4.7.5 SIEM. Vault issues short-lived IAM users (900 s lease). 33 alerts from 5 custom rules, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, from attacks simulated on localhost. The incident-response runbook is written but was not run against live alerts. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/identity-threat-detection-lab
2. Cloud Compliance and Vendor Risk Lab. Terraform, AWS Config and Security Hub (CIS AWS Foundations v1.4.0), EventBridge and Lambda writing a risk register to S3. 21 findings (17 mapped, 4 unmapped). ISO 27001 and NIST CSF mappings are indicative and analyst-assigned. A CLI scores a fictional vendor; a Flask dashboard shows both. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/cloud-compliance-vendor-risk
3. Cloud Support Simulation. Two support tickets on one EC2 instance in the default VPC: a security group fix found with CloudWatch Logs Insights, and a restore from an AWS Backup recovery point, checked directly because a recent file was missing. Access through AWS Client VPN (mutual TLS) and SSM Session Manager. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/cloud-support-ticket-simulation
4. Observability Stack on ECS Fargate. Prometheus (custom image in ECR) and Grafana on Fargate in ap-south-1, built with Terraform. Prometheus scrapes only itself; one Grafana alert on request rate. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/observability-fargate
5. AI Test Generator and GitOps Pipeline. FastAPI service calling Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant). Jenkins runs pytest with a 70% coverage gate, pushes to ECR and commits the image tag to a Helm chart repository for Argo CD on Minikube. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/ai-test-generator and https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/ai-pytest-generator-gitops
6. Self-Healing Java Microservice. Spring Boot in Docker on an Auto Scaling Group (2 to 4 t3.micro) behind an ALB, in Terraform. GitHub Actions with Snyk scans ran green in February 2026; Snyk runs after the image push, deployment to EC2 is manual, and CI now fails at the Docker Hub login because the secrets are no longer set. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/self-healing-microservice
7. Bookstore Serverless API. Node.js 20 Lambda behind an API Gateway REST API with CloudWatch Logs. The handler uses an in-memory array; a MongoDB Atlas cluster was set up but not connected. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/Bookstore-Microservice-Architecture-on-AWS
8. Patient Triage on Azure. Flask on Azure App Service (Linux, B1, Gunicorn) calling an Azure OpenAI gpt-4o deployment, logging each request to Azure Table Storage. Proof of concept with no authentication or rate limiting. https://github.com/SannidhiSriram-06/AI-Patient-Triage-System-on-Azure-CSA-Case-Study-

## Experience

AI Intern and Cloud Deployment Lead, Infosys Springboard (remote, February to April 2026). Led the cloud sub-team and co-led a 25-member team with the ML lead. Deployed an AI KYC verification system to AWS (React on S3, Node.js API and Flask ML service on EC2 under PM2) and fixed five deployment defects.
